family_name: Autex Solid Colour Frontier Raft beam

spec.description:
Autex Frontier Raft - Beam (Solid Colour) is a modular acoustic ceiling beam
system designed for targeted sound absorption in open-plan spaces. Constructed
from scored and folded 12mm Cube polyester felt locked with an extruded
aluminium channel, the Beam style is available in Beam 100 (87mm high x 70mm
wide) and Beam 250 (227mm high x 70mm wide). With an internal sound-dampening
air gap, it delivers high acoustic performance (NRC 0.75 - 0.95) in solid
through-core Cube colours while remaining lightweight and Group 1 fire
compliant.

install:
Plan
ceiling layout allowing recommended spacing (150mm centres for Beam 100; 300mm
centres for Beam 250)

Install Frontier mounting clips or suspension track
securely to structural ceiling

Slide RAFNEXRT aluminium extrusion into the
folded Beam raft top channel

Align Autex mounting clips with channel and
turn 45 degrees to temporarily position

Adjust along length and twist
clips 90 degrees to lock firmly into place

Fit black extrusion end caps to
beam ends for a clean aesthetic finish

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Solid Colour Frontier Raft - Beam is a lightweight modular
acoustic ceiling beam system crafted from 12mm Cube polyester felt into
rectangular profiles (Beam 100 at 87mm high and Beam 250 at 227mm high). Built
with an internal sound-absorbing air gap and anchored with an extruded aluminium
channel, it delivers high acoustic ratings (NRC 0.75 to 0.95) in 23+ solid
through-core colours. Achieving Group 1 fire compliance under AS ISO 9705 and
containing over 60% recycled PET, it provides an architecturally sleek,
lightweight alternative to solid timber or metal beams for commercial
interiors.
